title: 30-Year Treasury Bond auction (January reopening) — the third and final sale of the November 2026 bond, on a Wednesday
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes, PDF CreationDate 2026-08-04), FlateDecode streams inflated per page and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates. The page-3 row reads verbatim `30-Year BOND / R / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Wednesday, January 13, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027` — the `R` marks a REOPENING. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-07 coupon announcement. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-30y-bond-2026-12-10, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED, NOT CANONICAL. Filed because the calendar tracks treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10, -10-08, -11-12 and now -12-10 as first-class medium entries and then stops, and because this is the leg the proposing event's stance chains directly into: a nominal 30-Year is sold three times — a new issue in the refunding month, then a reopening in each of the two months after — so 2027-01-13 is the THIRD and final sale of the same bond the 2026-11-12 new issue creates and the 2026-12-10 reopening continues. Whichever CUSIP November prints is the CUSIP for both December and January. EXPECTED SIZE, from the grid rather than any published document: $22B, the standing 30-Year reopening size — 20 consecutive completed reopenings at exactly $22,000,000,000 from 2024-03-13 through 2026-07-09 (`api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov` `auctions_query`, pulled 2026-09-09, nominal-only after excluding 30-Year TIPS on a non-null `ref_cpi_on_issue_date`), plus 2026-09-10 announced at $22B; do NOT read across from the separate $25B new-issue streak. The number becomes published on 2027-01-07 and the size decision belongs to a quarterly refunding statement, not to that announcement. STRUCTURAL NOTE the proposing ledger measured and did not resolve: this leg sits on a WEDNESDAY, where the December and November legs sit on Thursdays; the January block runs 3-Year Monday 2027-01-11, 10-Year Tuesday 2027-01-12, 30-Year Wednesday 2027-01-13, all settling Friday 2027-01-15 — a compressed Mon/Tue/Wed shape whose driver a `never-assessed` session on this id should establish rather than inherit. NAMED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED here, so a sibling can: the 2027-01-07 coupon announcement (this event's own confirming primary) and the 2027-01-12 10-Year reopening. Reading it, not trading it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
